note: Tip length is .23″. Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "AT THIS TIME TIPS ARE CONSUMER INSTALLED" The product page also says: "TIPPING BLOCK INCLUDED WITH EACH ORDER" The product page also says: "The 35 Whelen is going to love this one. This pure copper lead free Hammer HHT™ will serve well in the dark timber to open country big game hunting. Tested down to 1800 fps for full expansion and shedding of the nose this Hammer HHT™ will give you a very wide range impact velocities to work with and have reliable terminal performance. Designed for a minimum twist of 1-16″ this will be good in most any .358 caliber rife. Not designed for tube feed magazines. The nose length on these is too long for SAAMI spec 350 Rem. Make sure your rifle has room to handle these."
